body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

https://github.com/rapidsai/cudf/pull/20161 is adding the rapdismpf runtime for executing cudf-polars queries. At the moment, it uses the default CUDA stream by default (see https://github.com/rapidsai/cudf/pull/20161/files#diff-9ad9c0b226771cfb2970dc29c34c5a9f2a384339d8c0258110ab141d33209ff7R277, and others).

- `local_shuffle_node`: https://github.com/rapidsai/cudf/pull/20161/files#diff-5b52d151dfa8bede82a81fcf2d51f20ec6428f3bb748986a7e17eec1564b99b2R216

**Describe the solution you'd like**

To get the best performance, we'd like to change the default to use the pool from rapidsmpf.

We have a few issues to sort out

1. Potential segfaults from incorrect CUDA stream usage (failing to synchronize / join streams correctly, just plain forgetting to pass through the `stream` to some pylibcudf call, ...)
2. Potential OOM errors, thanks to us using the GPU more efficiently / too aggressively
title: [FEA]: Change default cudf-polars stream pool policy to `pool`
